text:
Anya K: Hey team — planning to publish the docsite and regen SDK docs tomorrow during the 15:00 PT release window. Need confirmations on version bump, changelog, and branch cutover. :clock1:
Mike R: I can cut the release branch ~10m after the SDK regen. Which version are we bumping to?
Julian: We should go 0.9.4 -> 0.10.0 (semver minor) because of the config flag change. Changelog entry is in PR #842.
Samir: pinging @DocsOps for any outstanding redirects or frontmatter fixes. Also we need the docsite build target updated to the new tag.
DocsOps: I'm queued to run the publish. Please add the tag `release/v0.10.0` to the main PR and ensure SDK artifacts are uploaded to `gs://redwood-docs/artifacts/`. I'll kick off the site build after SDK docs show up. :white_check_mark:
Anya K: For the SDK docs regen the pipeline runs `./scripts/generate-sdk-docs.sh` and uploads artifacts. Can someone verify the script with the new tags? I'd prefer a staged regen in staging first.
Mike R: I'll run the script on staging now and post logs. If it succeeds I'll open a PR to bump the docs reference in the console repo.
Julian: ```bash
# quick local run
git checkout -b regen-sdk-v0.10.0
./scripts/generate-sdk-docs.sh --target=staging
# artifacts saved to gs://redwood-docs/artifacts/regen-v0.10.0.tar.gz
```
Samir: Staging run looks good, logs are clean but there are two warnings about `examples/auth.md` frontmatter (missing `sidebar_position`). @DocsOps can you patch? Also we need changelog approval from PM @Maya.
Maya: Approved the changelog content, small nit: rephrase the deprecation note to be clearer for users.
DocsOps: Fixed frontmatter and pushed a quick commit to PR #842. Ready for re-regeneration. I'll trigger site publish once the SDK artifact is present.
Anya K: Timeline proposal: 15:00 PT branch cut, 15:05 SDK regen, 15:20 site publish, 15:30 tag & release. If anything blocks we fallback to rolling docs back to previous site and skip the SDK regen. I'll add this to the release checklist.
Mike R: I'll add a smoke test post-publish: hit /health and run the example snippet against the console to verify docs samples. Will paste results here.
CI Bot: :deploy: Site publish queued by DocsOps — build id 6543. Logs: https://builds.redwood.ai/6543
Anya K: :thumbsup: thanks all. If you're reviewing PRs please prioritize #842 (changelog + examples) and #857 (console link updates). Trying to keep the cutover tight so we don't block the dedicated deploy later.
